sourceLimits: Main-app ContentView and SaysoUITests source identities are recorded here. The older keyboard binary included in this diagnostic build was not exercised by this method; this review makes no keyboard-layout claim.

DEBUG --uitesting --scripted-speech --scripted-long supplied a synthetic transcript exceeding 500 characters. This does not validate actual microphone capture, Speech recognition, Foundation Models, or a physical device.

Normal and AX-XXXL are app launch content-size overrides UICTContentSizeCategoryL and UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL, not a change to the simulator-wide preferred text size. All captures show Light appearance.
These are static landscape Home, recording, and Copied-result views. They do not establish animation continuity or the visibility of every result action in the same viewport.
Normal simulator execution succeeded without a security bypass; the separately recorded native runtime signature verification error -67054 remains unresolved.
imageValidity: All original PNG rasters are 1206 by 2622 with EXIF orientation 8 for landscapeLeft or 6 for landscapeRight, yielding the intended 2622 by 1206 presentation. Every image has zero fully near-black rows and columns (RGB channels all below 5). No source image was rotated, cropped, resized, recompressed, or metadata-normalized.
copyMethod: Byte-for-byte filesystem copy of original full-screen attachments; no image or metadata changes.

images.label: Landscape-Normal-Left-Home
images.visualFinding: Home title, waveform/subtitle, Import audio, branding, history/settings, mode, other-app recording icon, and microphone are fully visible without overlap.

images.label: Landscape-Normal-Right-Recording
images.visualFinding: Latest transcript lines remain readable above the waveform. The preceding line is clipped at the scroll viewport top as expected. Stop and Discard are fully visible in the separate bottom bar; no control overlaps the reading viewport.

images.label: Landscape-AX-XXXL-Left-Home
images.visualFinding: Home title, Import audio, branding, history/settings, mode, other-app recording icon, and microphone are fully visible without overlap. AX layout omits decorative waveform/subtitle and keeps the enlarged Original label inside the control bar.

images.label: Landscape-AX-XXXL-Right-Copied-Long-Result
images.visualFinding: The complete purple Copied action and its acknowledgement are visible above the bottom control bar; the final transcript text remains readable. Other result actions continue below in the vertical scroll view; only the top of the next Share action is visible.
